analysisDescription: Para cada tópico, relia o que este significava para certificar se compreendia corretamente, seguidamente selecionava o que é pertinente e escrevia seguidamente a justificação de ter selecionado.

dimensionExamples.example: Antes de fazer uma procura por uma partida, o jogador pode formar um grupo de amigos de até 5 jogadores no máximo, enviando convites na Steam.

dimension.title: Party Creation
dimension.description: Party Creation encompasses all games where groups are defined by the players themselves prior to initiating gameplay, typically leveraging friend lists or co-located party creation.

dimensionExamples.example: Se o grupo atual tiver menos que 5 jogadores, o matchmaking escolherá os jogadores do mesmo rank para completar uma equipa de 5.

dimension.title: Looking for Group
dimension.description: Looking for Group happens when there are grouping mechanisms that allow players to formally look for and create a group/party. This is typically achieved through matchmaking or looking for group queues.

dimensionExamples.example: O objetivo do jogo é destruir o ancient inimigo, aonde a partida acaba (ou se o anciente da equipa é destruída).

dimension.title: Shared
dimension.description: Shared goals consist of singular objectives that multiple players pursue and work together to achieve

dimensionExamples.example: Os jogadores podem concentrar em chegar num item ou mais, assim como evoluir o nível do personagem, ou fazer um mini-objetivo de matar o Roshan (criatura que quando morre, dá uma segunda vida a um dos jogadores), isso tudo influenciará em ter vantagem numa team fight.

dimension.title: Intertwined
dimension.description: Intertwined goals determine individual objectives assigned to different players that, in some way, are dependent on each other. The dependency may be uni- or bidirectional. If the dependency is bidirectional, goals are interdependent.

dimensionExamples.example: Cada jogador pode evoluir seu nível e ter os seus itens

dimension.title: Individual
dimension.description: Individual progression is defined by individual choice and the individual impact of the progression. In-game activities can vary from individual to fully cooperative but progression affects the individual.

dimensionExamples.example: O Jogador controla o personagem que escolheu no início da partida.

dimension.title: Single
dimension.description: Single applies to any game where players have control of one single entity.

dimensionExamples.example: Alguns heróis conseguem invocar unidades, ou transformar um npc inimigo (creeps adversários) ou hostil (creeps da jungle) numa unidade aliada, que consegue controlar.

dimension.title: Dispersed
dimension.description: Dispersed describes gameplay where players have control of multiple entities, which might be individually controlled or controlled as a group.

dimensionExamples.example: No inicio de uma partida do dota, o jogador tem que escolher 1 entre os 126 heróis existentes, deste que estes não estejam banidos ou escolhidos por outros jogadores

dimension.title: Pool
dimension.description: Pool describes when players are given an array of playable entities to choose from (e.g. characters, nations, class). These have predefined gameplay characteristics and in some cases, players can be forced to have a unique selection.

dimensionExamples.example: O herói evolui até chegar ao nível 30, tendo todas as habilidades desbloqueadas no máximo.

dimension.title: Predefined
dimension.description: When progress is strictly linear, with no player choice (e.g., dictated by the storyline, predefined upgrades or progressing through switching entities)

dimensionExamples.example: O jogador pode obtar por fazer várias builds de vários itens, e pode melhorar em qualquer ordem as habilidades

dimension.title: Customisable
dimension.description: Customisable encompasses all games with upgrades, levelling systems, and others that give players the ability to create and modify their representation throughout the game.

dimensionExamples.example: É um jogo de equipa de 5 contra outra equipa de 5.

dimension.title: Teammates
dimension.description: Teammates, where players within a team need to coordinate their actions, abilities, and roles in order to reach a common goal against at least another team.

dimensionExamples.example: Há vários momentos em que acontece team fights.

dimension.title: Competitors
dimension.description: Competitors, where you may be able to compete with other players, either momentarily or through the whole game session (e.g. team vs team match-based games).

dimensionExamples.example: Acontece no mesmo mapa, uma arena simétrica de 3 caminhos.

dimension.title: Shared
dimension.description: Shared world views apply to a game when players have access to the same world.

dimensionExamples.example: O jogador consegue ver no mapa a visão deixada por ele e pelos seus aliados (teammates, creeps e wards).

dimension.title: Unique
dimension.description: Unique world views correspond to the players having access to the same world but having unique perspectives on it (e.g. the different fog of war across teammates is a simple instance of a unique world view).

dimensionExamples.example: Cada jogador posiciona a sua câmara no mundo a sua preferência.

dimension.title: Distinct
dimension.description: Distinct refers to when each player has control of their own individual viewpoint, typically through separate screens.

dimensionExamples.example:
Para uma melhor otimização para vencer a partida, acontece uma separação de papéis de heróis entre os jogadores.
Existe o carry onde a sua função é evoluir o mais rápido possível e destruir os inimigos; o support, cuja função é ajudar o carry e atrapalhar o inimigo, fazendo assistências; offlaner onde o seu objetivo é atrapalhar a evolução do carry inimigo.

dimension.title: Coupled Collaboration
dimension.description: In coupled collaboration, players take on different tasks that somehow intertwine and typically contribute to a shared outcome.

dimensionExamples.example: O jogo é um MOBA (deriva-se do RTS)

dimension.title: Concurrent Collaboration
dimension.description: In concurrent collaboration, players have to perform gameplay tasks concurrently.

dimensionExamples.example: O jogador pode silenciar outros jogadores, e jogar a sua maneira deste que contribua a sua equipa.

dimension.title: Agnostic
dimension.description: When Agnostic, the game is neutral to player communication, it does not incentivise nor it places any restrictions. It is the only communication design that does not promote cooperation.

dimensionExamples.example: O jogo incentiva os jogadores comunicarem para a seleção de heróis, distribuição entre as lanes (caminhos do mapa), os itens que farão, se precisarem de ajuda ou não, ou quando reunir.

dimension.title: Required/Incentivised
dimension.description: When Required/Incentivised, the game challenges require players to communicate (e.g. when there is essential asymmetric information), or incentivised through challenges that are made easier through it (e.g. coordinating combined actions for maximum effect).

dimension.title: Text Chat
dimension.description: Support for players to communicate using text

dimensionExamples.example: Podem pingar no mapa, para avisar, atacar, ou recuar.

dimension.title: Pings
dimension.description: Support for players to communicate by signaling specific things in their view (e.g. aiming at something and signaling)

dimensionExamples.example: Tem uma roda de mensagens predefinidas pelos jogadores.

dimension.title: Premade Messages
dimension.description: Players can communicate through specific messages, previously created (possibly by the developers)

dimension.title: Voice Chat
dimension.description: Support for players to communicate using their voice

dimensionExamples.example: Desenham no mapa

dimension.title: Drawings
dimension.description: Support for players to communicate by drawing on a particular interface of the game (e.g. drawing a path plan on a map view)

dimension.title: Task
dimension.description: Task refers to gameplay tasks where at least one player is dependent on another. These can force players to coordinate to be effective and complete them.

dimensionExamples.example: Quando mais aliados participarem de uma team fight, mais vantagem têm.

dimension.title: Grouping
dimension.description: Grouping refers to activities that require a certain number of players to be accessed/completed.

dimensionExamples.example: Existem três lanes onde os jogadores têm que distribuir-se no começo.

dimension.title: Spatial
dimension.description: Spatial, inspired by Reuter et al. 2014, happens when the game forces or incentivises players to be at a certain distance from one another. This can happen in a variety of ways, for example, by creating a radius around which players cannot trespass or by designing mechanics that punish players that move too far away from the group.

dimensionExamples.example: O tempo de otimizarem o uso das habilidades, para um melhor combo contra os inimigos, por exemplo, um herói dar stun e logo em seguida o outro da stun no inimigo.

dimension.title: Temporal
dimension.description: Temporal, when there are temporal dependent events that affect both players. For example, ensuring action concurrencies or timing.

dimensionExamples.example: Os jogadores podem fazer uma assist ao ajudar a matar o heroi inimigo, seja dando dano ou stun ao herói inimigo, curar ou fortalecer o herói aliado.

dimension.title: Assistive Actions
dimension.description: Assistive Actions encompass actions that one player performs to the benefit of other/s (i.e. note that the player can have indirect benefits such as reviving others to increase their own chances of success). In these games, players can support and assist other players in achieving their objectives.

dimensionExamples.example: Os jogadores, geralmente os heróis support, podem partilhar os itens de cura de vida ou mana.

dimension.title: Consumables
dimension.description: Consumables refer to items that exist in a limited amount and can be utilised by players to invoke an effect (usually existing as a form of currency, materials, or food) or are not consumed on purpose by players but support the gameplay (e.g., health, energy). Consumables are shared when the agency to consume and manage them pertains to more than one player.

dimensionExamples.example: Os jogadores conseguem obter itens que regeneram instantaneamente a vida/mana, em dois locais, conseguem ganhar ouro em 2 locais, ganhar bónus temporário de buff em dois locais, e bónus de xp em dois locais do mapa.

dimension.title: Space
dimension.description: Space is also a resource as it defines the various places in the environment that a player can occupy and interact with. Space is shared when its utilisation is affected or constrained by others' presence or by others’ actions.

dimensionExamples.example: Há heróis que dão stun/debuffs no inimigo, dao buffs nos aliados.

dimension.title: Abilities
dimension.description: Abilities, as described by Harris et al. 2016, are where one player can do things another player cannot. In games where these actions synergise or are complementary, it incentivises collaboration.

dimensionExamples.example: Podem otimizar o uso sequencial de habilidades numa team fight.

dimension.title: Synergies
dimension.description: Synergies extended from Rocha et. al 2008 allow one entity to assist or change the game actions (e.g. abilities) of another.

dimensionExamples.example: Os papeis dos heróis ajudam a otimizar o progresso ao objetivo.

dimension.title: Complementarity
dimension.description: Complementarity, extended from Rocha et. al rocha2008game, corresponds to when player actions are designed to balance each other’s weaknesses or so that strengths complement each other. It is typically achieved through asymmetric game design, with each player bringing something to the shared experience.
